latest.title: LEVERAGING PARALLEL PATHWAYS, EXERCISE & COLD TO FOCUS & LEARN BETTER
latest.desc:
Moderate to intense exercise increases your levels of alertness and thereby your ability to focus. That focus increases your opportunity to learn new information and skills. 

**But exercise itself does not make you smarter per se** You still have to engage in the active process of learning and self
